decision: Prioritize receipt capture or approval rules

quotes.text: I spend Friday chasing missing receipts.
Approvals are slow because I cannot tell what is urgent.
I save receipts in my bag and forget them until month end.
The approval rule is fine for normal expenses; exceptions confuse people.
A reminder before the deadline would solve most of my issue.

decision_memo.primary_signal: Missing-receipt follow-up is the stronger repeated pain.
decision_memo.contradiction: Urgency may be a reminder problem, not a rules problem.
decision_memo.next_test: Prototype receipt reminders first; test exception guidance separately.
